title: Set Total Capital default value to 327

requirements.text: Update the backend default PerformanceMetrics value so that totalCapital is initialized to 327 (i.e., the value returned by getPerformanceMetrics should show totalCapital = 327 unless later changed via updatePerformanceMetrics), without changing any other metrics defaults or UI behavior.

quotes: Everything is fine but please only change total capital  327

acceptanceCriteria: In backend/main.mo, the initial performanceMetrics.totalCapital value is 327.0.
With a fresh canister state (no prior admin updates), getPerformanceMetrics returns totalCapital = 327.0.
All other default PerformanceMetrics fields remain unchanged (totalPnl=0.0, totalTrades=0, winningTrades=0, roi=0.0, maxDrawdown=0.0).
No frontend files are modified as part of this change.

constraints: Backend must remain a single-actor Motoko canister (all logic in backend/main.mo).
Do not modify any frontend immutable paths listed in SYSTEM_CONTEXT.
Make no other functional changes beyond setting totalCapital to 327.
nonGoals: Changing how Total Capital is formatted or displayed in the UI.
Changing any other performance metric values.
Adding new admin controls, routes, or settings for total capital.
